items.title: SiameseDuo++: Active Learning from Data Streams with Dual Augmented Siamese Networks
items.raw_content:
Authors: Kleanthis Malialis, Stylianos Filippou, Christos G. Panayiotou, Marios M. Polycarpou

Data stream mining, also known as stream learning, is a growing area which deals with learning from high-speed arriving data. Its relevance has surged recently due to its wide range of applicability, such as, critical infrastructure monitoring, social media analysis, and recommender systems. The design of stream learning methods faces significant research challenges; from the nonstationary nature of the data (referred to as concept drift) and the fact that data streams are typically not annotated with the ground truth, to the requirement that such methods should process large amounts of data in real-time with limited memory. This work proposes the SiameseDuo++ method, which uses active learning to automatically select instances for a human expert to label according to a budget. Specifically, it incrementally trains two siamese neural networks which operate in synergy, augmented by generated examples. Both the proposed active learning strategy and augmentation operate in the latent space. SiameseDuo++ addresses the aforementioned challenges by operating with limited memory and limited labelling budget. Simulation experiments show that the proposed method outperforms strong baselines and state-of-the-art methods in terms of learning speed and/or performance. To promote open science we publicly release our code and datasets.

items.summary: A developer released an open-source, self-hosted Model Context Protocol server for WhatsApp that connects through the WhatsApp Web multi-device API and stores messages locally in SQLite, letting an LLM search chats and send messages. items.title: Structured Extraction of Process Structure Properties Relationships in Materials Science
items.title_zh: 材料科学中工艺—结构—性能关系的结构化抽取
items.summary: Researchers propose an annotation schema for extracting process-structure-property relationships from materials science literature and test it on 128 abstracts from two domains. A fine-tuned GPT-4o beat a MatBERT-based CRF model on one domain, while the CRF became comparable after examples from the second domain were added.

items.title: Could AI Trace and Explain the Origins of AI-Generated Images and Text?
items.title_zh: AI 能否追溯并解释 AI 生成图像与文本的来源？
items.summary: Researchers introduce AI-FAKER, a multimodal dataset of more than 280,000 samples for detecting and tracing AI-generated images and text; they report that detection depends partly on a model's original training intent and that GPT-4o gives consistent but less specific explanations for OpenAI models' output.

items.title: A Deep Learning Approach to Anomaly Detection in High-Frequency Trading Data
items.title_zh: 高频交易数据异常检测的深度学习方法
items.summary: The paper describes a staged sliding-window Transformer for detecting anomalies in high-frequency EUR/USD trading data, reporting 0.93 accuracy, 0.91 F1 and 0.95 AUC-ROC against traditional and deep learning baselines.

items.title: rPPG-SysDiaGAN: Systolic-Diastolic Feature Localization in rPPG Using Generative Adversarial Network with Multi-Domain Discriminator
items.title_zh: rPPG-SysDiaGAN：基于多域判别器 GAN 的 rPPG 收缩-舒张特征定位
items.summary: The paper introduces a GAN architecture with discriminators focused on the time domain, frequency domain and the second derivative of the time-domain signal to extract rPPG signals from facial videos. The design aims to distinguish systolic and diastolic components rather than only estimate heart rate.

items.title: Improving Mixed-Criticality Scheduling with Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 用强化学习改进混合关键性调度
items.summary: The paper models non-preemptive mixed-criticality scheduling as a Markov decision process and trains an RL agent to produce near-optimal schedules that prioritize high-criticality tasks. Across 100,000 synthetic and real instances it reports about 80% overall task completion and 85% for high-criticality tasks, rising to 94% and 93% under stable conditions.

items.title: Systematic Literature Review on Vehicular Collaborative Perception -- A Computer Vision Perspective
items.title_zh: 车载协同感知系统综述——计算机视觉视角
items.summary: This PRISMA-based systematic review examines 106 papers on vehicular collaborative perception, covering modalities, collaboration schemes, perception tasks, and open challenges.

items.title: A discrete physics-informed training for projection-based reduced order models with neural networks
items.title_zh: 基于离散物理信息的投影降阶模型神经网络训练
items.summary: The paper adds a FEM-based discrete physics-informed residual loss to the PROM-ANN reduced-order modeling architecture and demonstrates it on a nonlinear hyperelasticity problem, where the modified model outperforms POD by orders of magnitude in snapshot reconstruction.
